name: Îlot de la supérette 25/8: espaces publics
about: The supermarket's block (ref/superette/, scripts/ilot/ilot_plan.gd, in its streets' frame): the ring of roads round it (one width, one asphalt, granite kerbs, centre and give-way lines, zebras) and the sidewalk all round the block, lowered across its accesses (Losplatos Custom's front its own); the site flat, the ring on a surface fitted to the ground; #785 and #889 out (lawn); the shop's forecourt and the footway to it; street trees, hedges, lamps, benches, bins, bike racks, bollards.
